annotations.title: Push a live interactive app onto the call stage

description: Pushes a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript multiplayer interactive app onto everyone's Make Live stage in a running Meetful call and returns its shareable /live/<id> link.

html.description: Complete inline HTML/CSS/JS fragment (<style>…</style>…<script>…</script>). No external script/CDN URLs, no localStorage, always preventDefault() on forms, support dark/light [data-theme="light"] CSS variables, and use window.meetfulLive for multiplayer state sync.

meeting.description: The meeting code (e.g. abc-defg-hij) or its link.

present.description: Show immediately on everyone's screen in the call. Default true.

prompt.description: Optional short summary of what was requested.

state.description: Optional initial shared JSON state object (no fake votes or placeholder people).

task.description: Optional Meetful task id (tmt_…) this build fulfills; automatically marks the task done with the live URL.

name: push_live_app
title: Push a live interactive app onto the call stage
